property_summary: For any two distinct senders A and B and nonzero payments vA and vB, if A funds twice (vA then vA2) and B funds once (vB) in between, the reference preserves cumulative balances per-address (userBalance(A) equals prior A deposits summed) whereas the mutant that overwrites on each deposit can make A's final stored balance equal only to its last single deposit (breaking per-address accumulation) — the test fuzzes two addresses and two amounts and detects the mutant.
change_summary: Replace the update to only set the balance to msg.value (overwrite rather than add), so addToBalance sets the caller's balance to the sent value.
